notes.title: Early Access Update
notes.content:
Announcement: Early Access Update Hello everyone, We want to thank all of you who have supported our game during Early Access. At this stage, we’ve identified some major development issues that prevent us from continuing with the current version of the game. Because of this, the Early Access build will be taken down until we can properly deliver the full experience we originally envisioned. For everyone who has purchased the Early Access version, we want to show our gratitude. 

Please reach out to us at nomuthegame@gmail.com with proof of purchase, and once the full release is ready, we will provide you with a free Steam key for the completed game. We deeply apologize for the inconvenience and truly appreciate your patience and understanding. 

This is not a goodbye—only a pause while we work hard to bring you the best version of the game possible. Thank you for being part of this journey with us.
